item.title: South Sudan: the situation
item.description:
Sudanese armed forces carried out a drone strike on Abyei’s Amiet market, killing dozens and injuring many, prompting South Sudan to summon Sudan’s envoy over the attack. A separate drone strike hit a market in the disputed Abyei border region, also causing high casualties. In Ruweng, fresh attacks left nine dead and six wounded, while bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. Communal clashes continued, including 14 deaths between Warrap and Lakes communities and the arrest of a traditional chief over a Juba youth killing. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Machine-written from the linked sources, checked for figures and names not in them.
